signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EnrichmentReport:
    run_id: str
    rows_written: int
    rows_dropped: int
    dropped_by_reason: dict[str, int]
    imputation_rate_by_feature: dict[str, float]
    unmatched_genre_count: int
    free_to_play_count: int
    duration_seconds: float
docstring:
Outcome of one enrichment stage run.

Attributes:
    rows_written: len(games_enriched rows written).
    rows_dropped: Candidates present in raw_games but excluded from games_enriched (currently only reason: non-'game' app_type).
    dropped_by_reason: {'non_game_app_type': N, ...} -- a dict so future drop reasons can be added without a shape change.
    imputation_rate_by_feature: {'achievement_count': 0.12, ...} -- fraction of written rows where that feature was median-imputed, one entry per complexity feature in FORMULATION.md section 4's table.
    unmatched_genre_count: Rows whose genre list matched no key in genre_bucket_map and fell back to the default bucket.
    free_to_play_count: Rows with NaN revenue due to the F2P policy.
    duration_seconds: Wall-clock stage time.
postconditions: rows_written + rows_dropped == the number of distinct appids present in the run's raw_games (across steamspy_all rows that also had at least an attempted appdetails fetch, i.e. the candidate set)
Every key in imputation_rate_by_feature has a value in [0.0, 1.0]

edge_cases.expected_behavior: rows_written=0, rows_dropped=0, imputation_rate_by_feature has all-zero entries (or is empty -- implementation choice, but must not raise a division-by-zero when rows_written is 0; convention chosen here: 0.0 for every feature when there are no rows to compute a rate over)

imputation_rate_by_feature shows ~1.0 (100%) for every log-scaled feature, which is expected and should be surfaced to the user as a caveat specific to pre-freeze runs, not treated as a data-quality bug

unit_tests.name: test_counts_are_internally_consistent
unit_tests.description: rows_written + rows_dropped equals the candidate count for a synthetic fixture.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_run_report_has_zero_counts_no_division_error
unit_tests.description: An empty candidate set produces a report with rows_written=0 and no exception from rate computation.
